subject: Integration milestone agreement & next steps (SDK + streaming + tool-calls)
messages:
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Patel <sana@healthsync.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@healthsync.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: integration milestones we discussed (SDK streaming / tool-calls)

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciated the clarity on your use case for in-product summarization + action extraction. I promised a short recap and a draft of milestone responsibilities so we can align on a target close.

High-level goal: HealthSync in-app clinical summarization (structured outputs) and a webhook-based tool-calling surface to trigger downstream workflows.

Draft MAP milestone subset (for engineering alignment):
- Milestone A (Week 0-2): SDK onboarding + authentication shim (owner: Redwood eng) — deliverable: sample SDK snippet, auth guide.
- Milestone B (Week 2-6): Streaming integration & KV cache validation (owner: HealthSync eng) — deliverable: streaming POC with 95th percentile latency <= 250ms for 512 tokens.
- Milestone C (Week 4-8): Tool-calls and webhook contract (owner: HealthSync product; Redwood to provide webhook spec and retries) — deliverable: contract doc + end-to-end test harness.
- Milestone D (Week 6-10): Structured output schema and eval sweep (owners: joint) — deliverable: canonical JSON schema + sample golden set for regressions.

Dependencies we flagged: internal procurement timelines (SOC 2 review), network egress firewall rules for streaming connections, and a small onboarding quota for burst testing.

Next steps:
1) Rajiv — please confirm internal owners and any hard target dates for procurement (procurement@healthsync.com is looped).
2) Ben/Aditya — attaching a first-pass action grid and SDK checklist for your review.
3) Sana — can you confirm that a March 26, 2026 target close works from your side? If not, propose an alternate week.

Attachments: redwood-healthsync-map-draft.xlsx (MAP action grid), sdk-integration-checklist.pdf

—
Lauren Bishop
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
From: Sana Patel <sana@healthsync.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@healthsync.com>, procurement@healthsync.com
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: integration milestones we discussed (SDK streaming / tool-calls)

Thanks Lauren — this is really helpful. Quick confirmations from HealthSync:
- We own Milestone B (streaming integration) and will assign an eng lead this week. Expected slot: mid-Feb sprint -> POC by end of Feb.
- Tool-call contract: product (me) + backend (Rajiv) will take point; we need Redwood to provide example webhook payloads and retry semantics.
- Procurement: our Security Ops lead needs the SOC 2 cert and a one-page data flow diagram. I’ve looped procurement but they may take ~3 weeks once docs are in.

Regarding the March 26 close: optimistic but doable if procurement moves fast. Can we aim for a soft-goal March 26 with the caveat that procurement may push a hard close into April?

Also one ask: for Milestone D (structured outputs), can Redwood provide an example structured-output.json to validate our mapping?

Thanks — Sana
Sana Patel
Head of Product, HealthSync
sana@healthsync.com
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Patel <sana@healthsync.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@healthsync.com>, procurement@healthsync.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: integration milestones we discussed (SDK streaming / tool-calls)

Appended a few clarifications and owners based on internal sync this morning.

Clarifications:
- SDK onboarding (Milestone A): owner at Redwood: Aditya (cc’d). We’ll push an auth shim (OAuth 2.0 + optional API key path), sample Node + Python snippets, and a small test harness by Feb 23.
- Streaming POC (Milestone B): HealthSync to provide a test corpus + a staging endpoint. Redwood will supply a streaming client that includes prefix caching and a simple perf harness. Aim: POC by Mar 4 to leave time for tuning.
- Tool-calls (Milestone C): Redwood will publish a webhook contract (payloads, idempotency key guidance, retry windows) and a Postman collection. Owner at Redwood: Ben. Owner at HealthSync: Rajiv.
- Structured outputs (Milestone D): I attached example-structured-output.json (simple three-field schema: summary / clinical_flags / actionables). We’ll run an eval sweep against your golden set once you provide it.

Risk note: procurement delay is the primary schedule risk — recommend we run integration tests behind a short-lived dev token while SOC 2 is reviewed. This avoids blocking the eng teams.

Attachments: example-structured-output.json

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Patel <sana@healthsync.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@healthsync.com, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@healthsync.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: integration milestones we discussed (SDK streaming / tool-calls)

Appreciate the quick turn, team. Small plan of record:
- Action: HealthSync to confirm internal eng lead by EOD Feb 19 (Rajiv / Sana).
- Action: Redwood (Aditya) to deliver SDK snippets + auth shim by Feb 23.
- Action: Ben to publish webhook contract + Postman collection by Feb 26.
- Contingency: Redwood will issue a temporary dev token for integration tests if procurement lags (security docs in parallel).

Target close: tentatively March 26, 2026 (soft). If procurement pushes, we’ll treat March 26 as a milestone for feature-complete integration with a commercial close in early April.

I’ve uploaded the MAP draft and a pared-down checklist to the shared drive (link below) and attached the spreadsheet snapshot to this thread. Please review owners and comment directly in the sheet.

Shared: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/integrations/healthsync/MAP-v1

If everyone is aligned, I’ll update the HubSpot MAP and send an updated version with concrete due dates on Friday.

—
Lauren
